title: ZPARQL REPL, schema reflection, and visual graph traversal dramatically elevate query ergonomics
summary: The addition of the interactive REPL console with meta-commands (.kinds, .tables, .schema) and real-time visual graph path projection (.visualize on) eliminates single-shot query friction and establishes a premier developer and agent experience.
recommendation: Maintain interactive console parity across future query engine extensions.

evidence.detail: cmd/zqk/query/repl.go and cmd/zqk/query/visualizer.go provide rich multi-line interactive editing and schema reflection.
